2: For the music director, with stringed instruments. A psalm. A song. May God be gracious to us and bless us. May he cause his face to shine toward us, Selah
3: that your way may be known on the earth, your salvation among all nations.
4: Let the peoples praise you, O God; let all of the peoples praise you.
5: Let the nations be glad and sing for joy, because you judge the peoples with equity and guide the nations on the earth. Selah
6: Let the peoples praise you, O God; let all the peoples praise you.
7: The earth has yielded its produce. God, our God, will bless us.
8: God will bless us, and all the ends of the earth will fear him.
